retry_reason.cause: The second script revision completed both reduced solves for all four levels, then looked up source.source_head although the contract field was named source_head_for_archived_fem_data. Payload construction failed before any output was written.
retry_reason.classified_change: Map the archived source field explicitly, add an upfront contract-schema check and verify the postprocessor SHA-256 before loading or solving.

hypothesis: The archived affine HEX8-SRI patch can be reconstructed from its stored global stiffness and prescribed boundary state, and two direct dense solvers produce equivalent free-DOF solutions; boundary work from the linearly ramped prescribed displacement matches strain energy.

model_scope.description: Four stored HEX8-SRI systems, each with 135 total DOFs and 9 interior free DOFs; the external affine displacement field and outer geometry are unchanged.
model_scope.interior_node_rule: ijk is strictly interior to divisions [4,2,2] in all three coordinates.

methods.name: scipy.linalg.cho_factor + cho_solve
methods.system: the same Kff and right-hand side; lower-triangular Cholesky factorization

observables.linear_residual: norm(Kff*uf-rhs,2), also reported relative to max(norm(rhs,2), tiny)
observables.method_difference: relative L2 difference between the two computed free displacement vectors
observables.archived_solution_difference: relative L2 difference between each new free solution and the archived displacement
observables.strain_energy_j: 0.5 * u.T @ K @ u using archived full stiffness and the reconstructed full displacement
observables.boundary_control_work_j: 0.5 * ub.T @ (K @ u)b; work for linearly ramping the archived prescribed displacements from zero, using the internal force on the constrained boundary
observables.continuum_reference: 0.1 J strain energy and +/-100 N axial end resultants for the homogeneous uniaxial field

prospective_checks: Verify the postprocessor SHA-256 and both input SHA-256 digests before loading or solving.
Require finite stored stiffness, relative infinity-norm asymmetry <= 100 * float64 epsilon, and positive-definite Kff for Cholesky factorization.
Require finite reconstructed displacements, reactions, energies and residuals.
Report all numerical differences descriptively; do not assign an acceptance PASS threshold or change historical status.
limitations: This is a post-processing reconstruction of a tiny stored linear system, not a new FEM execution.
Both methods use the same archived matrix, so agreement only checks the reduced solve and does not independently verify HEX8-SRI formulation or global-solver behavior.
The control-work identity applies to the archived linear elastic displacement ramp and does not define a general dynamic or nonlinear acceptance criterion.
